title: Allowance Schedule — The Addition for Repeated Failure, Belrose Promotional Financing Plans
content:
# Allowance Schedule — The Addition for Repeated Failure, Belrose Promotional Financing Plans

Where payments on a Belrose Promotional Financing Plan have come back unpaid while automatic payment was in force, the finance desk makes an addition to the give-back for the repeated failure.

| The plan | The addition for repeated failure |
|---|---|
| Two or more payments on it have been sent back unpaid inside the term's repricing review window, **and** automatic payment is in force on it | This desk's repeated-failure addition of **30.00 USD** |
| Exactly one payment has been sent back unpaid inside that window, **and** automatic payment is in force on it | This desk's single-failure addition of **15.00 USD** |
| Any other case | No addition is made for repeated failure |

Both bands require automatic payment to be in force: returns on a plan paying by any other arrangement add nothing, however many there are.

## The repricing review window by term

| Term | 6-Month Deferred Interest | 12-Month Deferred Interest | 18-Month Deferred Interest | 24-Month Equal Payment | 36-Month Equal Payment | 48-Month Bridal Equal Payment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Repricing review window, whole months | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 12 | 12 |

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- A plan on the 18-Month Deferred Interest Plan with automatic payment in force and three payments sent back unpaid inside the 6 whole months of its review window: 30.00 USD.
- The same plan with exactly one payment sent back unpaid inside that window: 15.00 USD.
- A plan on the 48-Month Bridal Equal Payment Plan with automatic payment in force and two payments sent back unpaid inside the 12 whole months of its review window: 30.00 USD.
- A plan with two returns inside its review window and no automatic payment: no addition is made for repeated failure.
